lines.serbian: Dina planira nedelju dana u Splitu i već tri večeri sedi nad mapom.
lines.croatian: Dina planira tjedan dana u Splitu i već tri večeri sjedi nad kartom.
lines.english: Dina is planning a week in Split and has spent three evenings poring over a map.

lines.serbian: Napravila je spisak mesta koja želi da vidi.
lines.croatian: Napravila je popis mjesta koja želi vidjeti.
lines.english: She has made a list of the places she wants to see.

lines.serbian: Prvog dana ide u Dioklecijanovu palatu, pa na Rivu na kafu.
lines.croatian: Prvog dana ide u Dioklecijanovu palaču, pa na Rivu na kavu.
lines.english: On the first day she's going to Diocletian's Palace, then to the Riva for coffee.

lines.serbian: Drugog dana penje se na Marjan, jer se odande vidi ceo grad.
lines.croatian: Drugog dana penje se na Marjan, jer se odande vidi cijeli grad.
lines.english: On the second day she's climbing Marjan, because you can see the whole city from there.

lines.serbian: Trećeg dana ide na plažu Bačvice da gleda kako ljudi igraju picigin.
lines.croatian: Trećeg dana ide na plažu Bačvice gledati kako ljudi igraju picigin.
lines.english: On the third day she's going to Bačvice beach to watch people play picigin.

lines.serbian: Četvrtog dana ide trajektom na Hvar.
lines.croatian: Četvrtog dana ide trajektom na Hvar.
lines.english: On the fourth day she's taking the ferry to Hvar.

lines.serbian: Petog dana ide na Zlatni rat, na Braču.
lines.croatian: Petog dana ide na Zlatni rat, na Braču.
lines.english: On the fifth day she's going to Zlatni Rat, on Brač.

lines.serbian: Šestog dana ide na izlet do Trogira.
lines.croatian: Šestog dana ide na izlet do Trogira.
lines.english: On the sixth day she's taking a trip to Trogir.

lines.serbian: Sedmog dana: pijaca, muzej i još jedan sladoled.
lines.croatian: Sedmog dana: tržnica, muzej i još jedan sladoled.
lines.english: On the seventh day: the market, a museum and one more ice cream.

lines.serbian: Plan šalje prijateljici Marini, koja je iz Splita.
lines.croatian: Plan šalje prijateljici Marini, koja je iz Splita.
lines.english: She sends the plan to her friend Marina, who is from Split.

lines.serbian: – Polako! Ovo nije plan, ovo je trka.
lines.croatian: – Polako! Ovo nije plan, ovo je utrka.
lines.english: "Slow down! This isn't a plan, it's a race."

lines.serbian: – U Splitu imamo jedno pravilo: pomalo.
lines.croatian: – U Splitu imamo jedno pravilo: pomalo.
lines.english: "In Split we have one rule: pomalo."

lines.serbian: – Jutarnja kafa traje dva sata. Posle toga vidimo.
lines.croatian: – Jutarnja kava traje dva sata. Nakon toga vidimo.
lines.english: "Morning coffee lasts two hours. After that, we'll see."

lines.serbian: Briše četiri stvari i sa osmehom piše na vrhu: „Pomalo.“
lines.croatian: Briše četiri stvari i s osmijehom piše na vrhu: „Pomalo.“
lines.english: She crosses out four things and, smiling, writes at the top: "Pomalo."
